topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class, reviews histopathology practicals, and outlines the learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Tumour viruses and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of transforming tumour viruses led to the discovery of cellular oncogenes and the development of assays to measure cellular transformation.

topics.label: Mechanisms of oncogenes and tumour suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the functional and genetic distinctions between oncogenes and tumour suppressor genes, illustrating their effects through cell cycle control and mutation types.

topics.label: Genetic instability and multistep tumour progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in DNA repair, replication, and chromosome segregation produce genetic instability and drive multistep tumour progression.

topics.label: Hereditary cancer predisposition and tumour evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inherited germline mutations accelerate cancer development and influence subsequent tumour evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, offers to answer questions, recommends reading material, and previews the next lecture.
